description: This file defines the interface 'ModifyThingLiveCommand' which extends other interfaces to provide live command functionality for modifying a 'Thing' within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes a method to retrieve the 'Thing' being modified.

classes.name: ModifyThingLiveCommand
classes.description: An interface providing access to a live 'modify thing' command, including a method to retrieve the target 'Thing' object.

methods.name: getThing
methods.description: Returns the 'Thing' object that is to be modified.
